mono.purpose: WGS84 coordinates, distances, and tabular counters.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Card hover lift and floating map controls.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Search bar, autocomplete dropdown, dialogs, and map popups.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Responsive UI entrances and hover feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action control across navbar, hero search, and map actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0d5c53; color: #fffdf9; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: none; transition: background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #094740; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d5c53; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Atlas Card
components.description: Editorial destination card with warm hairline border at rest and offset elevation on hover.
components.css: .ds-card-atlas { background: #fffdf9; color: #16201d; border: 1px solid #e3ddd1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.22s, box-shadow 0.22s; } .ds-card-atlas:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(13,92,83,0.42); box-shadow: 0 14px 32px -10px rgba(17,26,24,0.12); }

narrative.overview: Quảng Ngãi Atlas combines archival Vietnamese heritage typography with daylight field-guide clarity on warm limestone paper, deep basalt stages, and coastal jade accents.
keyCharacteristics: Warm limestone canvas (#f7f4ee) with crisp 1px warm borders (#e3ddd1).
Vietnamese-subset Source Serif 4, Be Vietnam Pro, and JetBrains Mono.
Flat cards at rest with structural elevation only on hover or floating overlays.
Full prefers-reduced-motion parity across CSS, GSAP, and Lenis.

rules.name: The Accessible Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber fills (#f59e0b) always pair with Deep Basalt Ink (#16201d).

rules.name: The Honest Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved strictly for WGS84 coordinates, numeric distances, and tabular counters.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Never stack a 1px border beneath a permanent blurry shadow on static cards.

dos: Do preserve vietnamese font subsets and tabular-nums on coordinates and distances.
Do enforce minimum 44px touch targets on interactive controls.
donts: Don't place eyebrow kickers above section headings or decorative 01/02/03 badges.
Don't use gradient text fills, glowing shadows, or internal CMS labels on tourist pages.
